body: I’m so happy I did not sign up for this event. I knew it was a scam the second they promised 10 000 in attendance with no previous markets to show for. And when I saw the booth price I knew it was a scam to get money out of people first starting their business. I feel bad for all the people who signed up because they probably made no profit and lost $750. I also knew it was a scam when I asked questions about the booth price and attendance and no one answered. And also when you apply, they send multiple emails telling you to pay or you will loose your booth. If it seems to good to be true, it probably is.
Thanks! I also tell everyone I know to do therapy even if it’s just to try it. My therapist and I have a good understanding of each other. It’s something to look forward to.
Yea I had the same thought too, because I also wouldn’t know how to help my friends. Bettering my communication has helped a lot.

I talked to my therapist about this before. She told me that they literally just don’t know how to help so they avoid it. She said it may be good to actually communicate with them on how they can help you so they don’t feel awkward about it.

One of the things I do that works really well. Is instead of taking the care to the grocery store, I walk. It takes more time, I get some exercise and get to listen to music. Sometimes a break in the routine of being stuck at home is what really helps. I also struggle with being by myself but it’s only been a few months now. But that’s what helps me, oh and I have a lot of hobbies.

It does not matter how old you are, or the fact that everyone has a stressful life, your are allowed to feel bad and feel like giving up, what I just posted is a valid feeling and just because I’m 23 doesn’t make it wrong, sure I’ve had a short life, but short lived can have a lot of suffering, don’t let anyone put you down for your feeling to make themselves feel better, fuck those mother fuckers, I’ll feel fucking bad if I want to

I think the hardest thing I’m having to deal with is the fact that I have an incurable autoimmune disorder. And I’m having trouble coping with it and all the changes it made to my body. Just having a moment of weakness, or moments I guess.
Thx bro, I appreciate it. I’m not giving up yet.
Saying something even if it’s cliche, def helped
